header.one_liner: UK propeller-systems OEM (GE Aerospace) that makes the six-blade R391 composite propeller for the C-130J Super Hercules — the type flown by the Indian Air Force. Component supplier — Tier C.
header.indigenous_label: Foreign component/sub-system supplier — no standalone India footprint

at_a_glance.India_relevance: R391 six-blade composite propeller fitted to IAF C-130J Super Hercules fleet
at_a_glance.Tier_C_reason: Embedded propeller supplier via the airframer; no standalone India defence order card

what_it_is.prose: Dowty Propellers, a GE Aerospace business based in Gloucester (UK), designs and manufactures composite propeller systems. Its six-blade R391 propeller equips the Lockheed Martin C-130J Super Hercules, the type operated by the Indian Air Force, so Dowty hardware flies on IAF C-130J aircraft as an embedded sub-system supplied through the airframer rather than under a discrete, publicly documented India contract. Recorded as an honest Tier C component-supplier card.
